faqs.question: What does “verified” actually mean on a listing?
faqs.answer: A surveyor and a lawyer from our team visit in person, take timestamped photography, and check the RAJUK approved plan, mutation porcha, khatiyan and non-encumbrance certificate. If any link in the chain is doubtful, the listing is rejected.

faqs.question: Is the listed price the real price?
faqs.answer: Yes. It reflects the agreement with the verified owner, and it is the number you negotiate down from. We hand you an exact closing-cost statement upfront — stamp duty, registration tax, gain tax and our fee — with nothing added later.

faqs.question: I live abroad. Can I buy without flying back?
faqs.answer: Yes. We run live walkthroughs in your timezone, prepare the consular power of attorney for your nearest mission, and complete registration at the sub-registry office. Most purchases close in six to ten weeks without the buyer landing.

faqs.question: How do you track construction progress?
faqs.answer: Our engineers inspect active sites every thirty days. The progress meter reflects audited milestones — piling, frame, MEP, interior — backed by dated site photography, not a developer brochure.

faqs.question: Can landowners partner on a joint venture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send the land details and we come back with a feasibility report, the owner share, bank-backed signing security and a delivery date written into the contract.

faqs.question: Do you arrange home loans?
faqs.answer: We take your file to the banks currently offering the best rate for your profile and push pre-approval through in about seventy-two hours. We take nothing from the bank for it, so the recommendation is not bought.

story.whyTitle: Why choose us as a partner for your land?
story.whyBody: Dealing with a developer in Dhaka is hard to judge from the outside — the joint venture process is bureaucratic, and the promises all sound alike. We put the terms in the deed instead of the brochure: the owner share, the signing advance held in bank escrow, and a handover date you can enforce. Read what our landowners say, then look at what we finished.
story.differentBody: We took the legal work in-house rather than subcontracting it, so the title search that decides whether a joint venture is safe is done by people who answer to you. Our engineers inspect every active site each month, and the completion figure you see is the one they signed off. If a timeline is slipping we tell you before you hear it from a neighbour.

story.moreBody: Send us the plot address and the deed. Within two weeks you get a feasibility report — what can legally be built there, how many units, and the share we can offer, in writing. No obligation, and the papers stay yours.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: What you agree to when you use this site, make an enquiry, or view a property with us.
terms.metaDescription: The terms that govern the use of Zoom Property's website, enquiries and viewings.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Zoom Property is a licensed real estate agency operating in Dhaka and Chattogram. “We” and “us” in this document mean Zoom Property; “you” means anyone using this website or dealing with us through it.

sections.title: What this website is
sections.body: This site advertises property we have been instructed to sell or let. Every listing has been inspected by our survey team and its title documents read before publication. A listing is an invitation to enquire, not an offer capable of acceptance — nothing on this site forms a contract of sale.

sections.title: Accuracy of listings
sections.body: Measurements, prices, completion dates and construction percentages are given in good faith and were correct on the date of inspection shown on the listing. Availability and price can change without notice. Before you commit money, verify everything independently through your own lawyer and surveyor — we will hand over every document we hold to help you do so.

sections.title: Enquiries and viewings
sections.body: An enquiry places you under no obligation and costs nothing. We do not charge buyers or tenants a search fee. Viewings are arranged with the owner’s consent and at their convenience; we ask that you give reasonable notice if you cannot attend.

sections.title: Fees
sections.body: Our commission is payable by the party who instructed us, on the terms set out in their agency agreement. Any fee payable by you will be stated in writing before you are asked to commit to anything. We do not take a markup on the price shown.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
sections.body: You agree not to scrape, republish or resell the content of this site, not to submit enquiries on behalf of someone who has not asked you to, and not to use our contact details to send unsolicited marketing.

sections.title: Our liability
sections.body: We are responsible for the accuracy of what we tell you and for the care we take in inspecting a property. We are not liable for the acts of a developer, an owner, a bank or a government office, nor for loss arising from a decision you took without the independent advice we recommended.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may revise these terms. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed. Continuing to use the site after a change means you accept the revised version.

sections.title: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law of Bangladesh, and the courts of Bangladesh have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising from them.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms go to the desk — the phone number and email address on our contact page reach a person, not a queue.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What we collect when you enquire, why we hold it, and what we will never do with it.
privacy.metaDescription: How Zoom Property collects, uses and protects the personal information you give us.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.body: Only what an enquiry needs: your name, your phone number, your email address if you give one, and what you told us you are looking for. We do not ask for your national ID, your bank details or your income to answer an enquiry.

sections.title: Why we hold it
sections.body: To reply to you, to shortlist properties that fit what you asked for, and to arrange viewings. That is the whole of it. If you stop replying, the record stops being used.

sections.title: What we never do
sections.body: We do not sell your details. We do not pass them to developers, banks or third-party agents so they can market to you. A developer learns your name when you ask us to arrange a viewing with them, and not before.

sections.title: Cookies
sections.body: This site sets a cookie to remember your language choice, and nothing else that identifies you. There is no advertising tracker and no cross-site profiling on these pages.

sections.title: How long we keep it
sections.body: An enquiry record is kept for as long as it is useful to you — through the search, and for the period afterwards in which a buyer typically comes back. Ask us to delete it and we delete it.

sections.title: Who can see it
sections.body: The advisors working on your enquiry, and the staff who administer our systems. Access is logged. Nobody outside the company sees your details without your say-so.

sections.title: Where it is stored
sections.body: On managed servers with encrypted storage and encrypted transfer. Documents you send us — papers, photographs — are held in the same place under the same controls.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, and ask us to delete it. Write to the address on our contact page and we will answer within a working week.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: This site is for adults transacting in property. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under eighteen.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
sections.body: The date at the top of this page shows when this policy last changed. A change that materially affects what we do with your information will be told to you directly, not just posted here.

faq.description: Answers from the Zoom Property brief only. Covered area and the share price are not printed here — Zoom has not published a rate card.

items.question: Where is Zoom Al-Zahra?
items.answer: Basila Garden City, Mohammadpur, Dhaka — inside the city, not on a new-town access road. Dhanmondi 27 is 3.6 km, about 11 minutes.

items.question: How far are the usual places?
items.answer: Times Zoom published with the project: Rayerbazar 14 minutes, Farmgate 19, Gabtoli 20, New Market 21, Dhaka University 24, Mirpur-10 and Gulshan-1 26, Motijheel and the airport 31, Uttara 42.

items.question: How much land is there?
items.answer: 4.29 katha. That is the figure Zoom has printed. Covered square footage of each flat is confirmed at the desk, not on a public rate card.

items.question: How many floors and how many units?
items.answer: Ground plus nine — ten floors. Two residences on each residential floor. Eighteen homes in all if the ground floor is the lobby.

items.question: What is in each flat?
items.answer: One plan only: 4 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, one kitchen, separate dining and drawing, 3 balconies. There is no second product and no duplex upsell.

items.question: What is the square footage and the price?
items.answer: Zoom has published the land — 4.29 katha — not a covered-area rate card or a flat price. The land-share figure and the unit square footage are given at the booking desk: 01711-250406 and 01711-250407.

items.question: What does land share mean here?
items.answer: You buy a share of the 4.29 katha first. The G+9 is then built with the buyers, so construction spend stays in view. It is not a finished tower sold as a finished product.

items.question: Is the building ready to move into?
items.answer: No. Booking is for the land share. The block goes up after, with the people who booked. Zoom has not published a handover month.

items.question: Is there a lift?
items.answer: Yes. A 10-person lift and a wide stair serve the ten floors.

items.question: What sits in front of the plot?
items.answer: A 58-foot lake and 25 feet of open front, so the elevation reads from the road.

items.question: What is already around the plot?
items.answer: Named in the Zoom brief: Sun Care Hospital, Victorious International School, Shwapno and the bazaar, two mosques, banks, the thana, Tajmahal Park and Mohammadpur Club Park.

items.question: How do I book or walk the plot?
items.answer: Call or WhatsApp 01711-250406 or 01711-250407, or send the form on this page. The desk confirms the share, the covered area and a time to visit — the original films are on facebook.com/zoompropertyltd.
